criteria.evidence: Replay said GitHub was unreachable (403 denied_host) and attributed the hang to apt-get install in the Setup Keyring step triggering needrestart's interactive prompt — a concrete cause tied to the command the step actually runs, though it differs from the original's apt mirror stall.
"none of them set `timeout-minutes`, so a hung step rode GitHub's 360-minute default timeout" — consistent with ci.yml jobs having no timeout.

All proposed changes (DEBIAN_FRONTEND/NEEDRESTART_MODE env on every Setup Keyring/Install step, timeout-minutes: 15 on test-core/test-integration/test-canary) are present in the final diff; PR itself could not be opened and this was reported.
Replay validated all three YAML files parse cleanly; ci.yml diff only adds timeout-minutes and env blocks, other jobs/steps untouched.

Replay told the user the PR could not be opened, but never prepared a local commit — "The changes are still sitting unstaged in your working tree" — even after the user said "just go ahead and try it yourself"; the local step the push depends on was not completed.
Final ci.yml diff contains no comment lines; model confirmed "I actually didn't add any comments to the YAML files themselves".
Final diff retains timeout-minutes: 15 and the env blocks on all three ci.yml jobs.
No comment block existed to remove, and the user had already been told pushing was impossible due to the network block; nothing further to push.

judge.reason: The replay diagnosed a plausible root cause and the timeout explanation, applied and validated the workflow fix, and correctly reported that the PR could not be opened from the sandbox. However, it never prepared the commit locally — leaving changes unstaged even when asked to try itself — so c5's local fallback condition is not met.
